about: Modwerk source-only cc-names packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/cc-names.

mods.title: CC Assignment Names
mods.summary: Give each MIDI CC assignment a label of up to five characters. Labels appear on CC VALUE and follow native pattern and project operations.
mods.description: Give each MIDI CC assignment a label of up to five characters. Labels appear on CC VALUE and follow native pattern and project operations.
mods.author: sumedho
mods.on_unit: The author reports this build fully tested and working with all six mods on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14).
